operations.raw_sql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT c.subscription, c.change_type, c.locked_rate, c.currency,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.subscription ORDER BY c.effective_at DESC, c.creation DESC) AS rn
  FROM `tabSubscription Change` c
  WHERE c.change_type IN ('Created', 'Plan Changed', 'Cancelled')
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.currency = 'INR' THEN l.locked_rate ELSE 0 END), 0) AS run_rate_inr,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.currency = 'USD' THEN l.locked_rate ELSE 0 END), 0) AS run_rate_usd
FROM latest l
JOIN `tabSubscription` s ON s.name = l.subscription
WHERE l.rn = 1 AND l.change_type != 'Cancelled' AND s.enabled = 1
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabTax Profile` tp WHERE tp.team = s.team AND tp.is_internal = 1)

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabWebhook Event` WHERE status = 'Failed'
    OR (status = 'Received' AND creation < NOW() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE)) AS webhooks_stuck,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabInvoice` WHERE erpnext_sync_status = 'Failed') AS sync_failed,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabInvoice` WHERE status = 'Draft' AND hold_reason IS NOT NULL AND hold_reason != '') AS on_hold,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabSubscription` WHERE enabled = 1 AND account_standing IN ('Past Due', 'Suspended')) AS past_due,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabSubscription` WHERE enabled = 1) AS subscriptions,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(balance), 0) FROM `tabCredit Wallet` WHERE currency = 'INR') AS wallet_inr

WITH period AS (SELECT LAST_DAY(CURDATE() - INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AS period_end),
invoices AS (
  SELECT i.name, i.status, i.hold_reason, i.amount_paid, i.creation, i.modified, i.paid_at,
    i.erpnext_sync_status, i.erpnext_synced_at, CASE
    WHEN i.status = 'Waived' THEN 'Our own teams (waived)'
    WHEN i.status = 'Draft' AND COALESCE(i.hold_reason, '') != '' THEN 'Held for details'
    WHEN i.status = 'Draft' THEN 'Not collected yet'
    WHEN i.status IN ('Open', 'Overdue') THEN 'Unpaid'
    WHEN i.amount_paid <= 0 THEN 'Credit only'
    ELSE COALESCE((
      SELECT pm.method_type FROM `tabPayment Attempt` pa
      JOIN `tabPayment Method` pm ON pm.name = pa.payment_method
      WHERE pa.invoice = i.name AND pa.status IN ('Captured', 'Refunded') LIMIT 1
    ), 'Paid, no payment record')
  END AS settled_as
  FROM `tabInvoice` i, period p
  WHERE i.period_end = p.period_end AND i.invoice_type = 'Billable' AND i.status != 'Cancelled'
),
attempts AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS attempts, COALESCE(SUM(pa.status = 'Failed'), 0) AS failed
  FROM `tabPayment Attempt` pa JOIN invoices i ON i.name = pa.invoice
),
run AS (SELECT br.* FROM `tabBilling Run` br, period p WHERE br.period_end = p.period_end)
SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT teams FROM run), (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT team) FROM `tabSubscription`)) AS teams,
  COUNT(i.name) AS drafted,
  COALESCE(SUM(i.status != 'Draft'), 0) AS settled,
  COALESCE(SUM(i.settled_as = 'Held for details'), 0) AS held,
  COALESCE(SUM(i.settled_as = 'Credit only'), 0) AS by_credit,
  COALESCE(SUM(i.settled_as = 'Card'), 0) AS by_card,
  COALESCE(SUM(i.settled_as = 'UPI Autopay'), 0) AS by_upi,
  COALESCE(SUM(i.settled_as = 'Unpaid'), 0) AS unpaid,
  (SELECT failed FROM attempts) AS failed_payments,
  (SELECT attempts FROM attempts) AS payment_attempts,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabError Log` e, period p
    WHERE e.method = 'Billing Run Failure' AND e.creation >= p.period_end) AS run_errors,
  COALESCE(SUM(i.erpnext_sync_status = 'Failed'), 0) AS sync_failed,
  COALESCE(SUM(i.erpnext_sync_status IN ('Synced', 'Failed')), 0) AS sync_tried,
  COALESCE(ROUND(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, MIN(i.creation), MAX(i.creation)) / 60, 1), 0) AS draft_hours,
  COALESCE(ROUND(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, (SELECT started_at FROM run),
    COALESCE((SELECT completed_at FROM run), NOW())) / 60, 1), 0) AS run_hours,
  COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, i.paid_at, i.erpnext_synced_at)), 0), 0) AS sync_minutes,
  COALESCE(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, COALESCE(MAX(i.modified), (SELECT started_at FROM run)), NOW()), 0) AS minutes_since_progress
FROM invoices i

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT c.subscription, c.change_type, c.locked_rate, c.currency,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.subscription ORDER BY c.effective_at DESC, c.creation DESC) AS rn
  FROM `tabSubscription Change` c
  WHERE c.change_type IN ('Created', 'Plan Changed', 'Cancelled')
),
metal AS (
  SELECT region, SUM(cost_per_month_inr) AS cost, SUM(vcpus) AS vcpus,
    SUM(memory_gib) AS memory_gib, SUM(disk_gib) AS disk_gib, COUNT(*) AS machines
  FROM `tabMetal Server` WHERE status = 'Active' GROUP BY region
),
rate AS (
  SELECT s.server_id, l.locked_rate, l.currency
  FROM `tabSubscription` s JOIN latest l ON l.subscription = s.name AND l.rn = 1
  WHERE s.enabled = 1 AND s.server_id IS NOT NULL AND s.server_id != '' AND l.change_type != 'Cancelled'
),
servers AS (
  SELECT v.name AS server, v.team, t.team_name, v.region, v.status,
    COALESCE(v.vcpus, 0) AS vcpus, COALESCE(v.memory_megabytes, 0) / 1024 AS memory_gib,
    COALESCE(v.disk_gigabytes, 0) AS disk_gib,
    CASE
      WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabTax Profile` tp WHERE tp.team = v.team AND tp.is_internal = 1) THEN 'Internal'
      WHEN (SELECT MAX(st.trial_state) FROM `tabSite` st WHERE st.server = v.name AND st.trial_state != '')
        IN ('Active', 'Ended', 'Deleted') THEN 'Trial'
      WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabSite` st WHERE st.server = v.name AND st.trial_state != '')

        WHEN a.first_active IS NOT NULL THEN 'Method added, not billed yet'

      WHEN a.first_active <= f.first_failure + INTERVAL 30 DAY THEN 'Fixed method, not billed yet'
      WHEN f.first_failure > NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY THEN 'Window still open'

    o.outcome = 'Window still open' AS window_open,
    o.outcome = 'Lost' AS lost,

      WHEN DATEDIFF(o.first_paid, o.first_failure) = 0 THEN '1. Same day'

  FROM outcomes o

  FROM `tabInvoice`
  WHERE invoice_type = 'Billable' AND status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Waived')

  GROUP BY month

  SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(created_at), INTERVAL DAYOFMONTH(created_at) - 1 DAY) AS month,

  FROM `tabRefund`
  WHERE status = 'Completed' AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(DATE_SUB(DATE(CURDATE()), INTERVAL DAYOFMONTH(CURDATE()) - 1 DAY), INTERVAL 24 MONTH)
  GROUP BY month

    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ms.cost_per_month_inr), 0) FROM `tabMetal Server` ms

  LEFT JOIN server_region s ON s.region = r.region
  LEFT JOIN card k ON k.region = r.region
)

SELECT region, machines, servers, bill, sellable_vcpus, sold_vcpus,
  sold_vcpus / NULLIF(sellable_vcpus, 0) AS vcpu_sold_share,
  potential,
  potential - held_value AS unsold,
  held_value - paid_value AS unpaid,
  unpaid_cost,
  paid_value - revenue AS discount,
  revenue,
  revenue / NULLIF(potential, 0) AS yield_share,
  revenue / NULLIF(sellable_vcpus, 0) AS revenue_per_sellable_vcpu
FROM totals
